name: plunk
//next-resolution: @react-email/preview-server hard-pins next@16.0.1, which carries CVE-2025-66478 (critical) among others. It is a dev-only preview tool and never ships in the image, but Railway's build-time vulnerability scanner reads yarn.lock wholesale and refuses to build while any vulnerable version is resolved. Pinning it to the ^16.2.11 the three Next apps already use collapses the lockfile to a single next version. Drop this once preview-server ships a patched pin.
//zod: apps/mcp needs zod 4 (the MCP SDK requires it) while the rest of the monorepo is on zod 3. Declaring zod 3 here keeps it as the hoisted root copy so packages that import zod without declaring it — @hookform/resolvers in web, and anything else that relies on hoisting — keep resolving 3. zod 4 nests under apps/mcp. Remove this only when the whole repo moves to zod 4.
